_about: Voice lines for Ball Knowledge. tools/voices.js turns each line into public/audio/vo/<id>.mp3 with ElevenLabs. Voices are matched by name in your ElevenLabs library (first match wins); set VOICE_<SPEAKER> env vars to force a voice id.

sal.direction: older, gravelly East-coast mob boss; calm, amused, menacing

bartender.direction: dry, quick, seen-it-all woman behind a dive bar

vinnie.direction: very old regular, raspy, conspiratorial, a little wistful

lines.speaker: sal
lines.text: You each owe me five hundred dollars. From last time. ...You remember last time.

lines.speaker: sal
lines.text: Tonight, you work it off. Hit my number by game three. Then more. Then more.

lines.speaker: sal
lines.text: And remember... I always collect.

lines.speaker: sal
lines.text: Back again. The marker's seven-fifty now. Plus whatever you still owe me.

lines.speaker: sal
lines.text: Last night. Clear my books tonight... and you walk out of here free.

lines.speaker: sal
lines.text: Come up short... and you don't walk out.

lines.speaker: sal
lines.text: Just a friendly reminder, kid. Let's see what you do.

lines.speaker: sal
lines.text: Come here. Let's talk about what you owe me.

lines.speaker: sal
lines.text: I can make things happen, kid. For a price.

lines.speaker: sal
lines.text: Not bad, kid. Now go make me some money.

lines.speaker: sal
lines.text: I told you, kid. ...I always collect.

lines.speaker: bartender
lines.text: First time? Bets go in at the terminal under the TVs. Pick a winner.

lines.speaker: bartender
lines.text: Paper's on the counter. Sharp guys read it. It can tell you what year it is.

lines.speaker: bartender
lines.text: A little buzz helps the gut. Too much, and it lies to you.

lines.speaker: bartender
lines.text: Short on cash? I always have work. Come ask me.

lines.speaker: bartender
lines.text: What'll it be?

lines.speaker: bartender
lines.text: Nice work. Here's your cut.

lines.speaker: vinnie
lines.text: Psst. Kid. Buy an old man a drink and I'll tell you who wins.

lines.speaker: vinnie
lines.text: Listen. I seen a hundred of these. Mark it down.

lines.speaker: hitman
lines.text: You came up short. Sal wants his money.

lines.speaker: hitman
lines.text: Friendly reminder from Sal.

lines.speaker: hitman
lines.text: Sal sends his regards.

lines.speaker: hitman
lines.text: Sal wants a word. In the back.

lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: And we are underway!

lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: And that is the ball game!
